targets.query: SELECT state, COUNT(*) as count FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = 'pipeline_corretora_santander' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY state

SELECT execution_date, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_date - start_date)) / 60 as duration_minutes FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = 'pipeline_corretora_santander' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY execution_date DESC

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as success_rate FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = 'pipeline_corretora_santander' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

SELECT CASE WHEN task_id LIKE 't0_%' THEN 'Setup' WHEN task_id LIKE 't1_%' THEN 'Ingestion' WHEN task_id LIKE 't2_%' THEN 'Silver' WHEN task_id LIKE 't3_%' THEN 'Gold' WHEN task_id LIKE 't_sql_%' THEN 'SQL' ELSE 'Other' END as layer, COUNT(*) as count FROM task_instance WHERE dag_id = 'pipeline_corretora_santander' AND execution_date = (SELECT MAX(execution_date) FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = 'pipeline_corretora_santander') GROUP BY layer

SELECT CASE WHEN task_id LIKE 't0_%' THEN 'Setup' WHEN task_id LIKE 't1_%' THEN 'Ingestion' WHEN task_id LIKE 't2_%' THEN 'Silver' WHEN task_id LIKE 't3_%' THEN 'Gold' WHEN task_id LIKE 't_sql_%' THEN 'SQL' ELSE 'Other' END as layer, task_id, COUNT(*) as failures FROM task_instance WHERE dag_id = 'pipeline_corretora_santander' AND state = 'failed' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY layer, task_id ORDER BY failures DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT DATE(execution_date) as date, COUNT(*) as runs FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = 'pipeline_corretora_santander' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
